title: Verify selecting a single category filter returns only matching products
preconditions: Products page (https://dev.skyline.glass/products/) is loaded, no filters active
steps: Open the category filter checkbox list
Check the 'Smart Glass' category checkbox
Wait for the page to reload with ?product_category[]=<Smart Glass id>
Count the displayed product results
expected_result: Only the 3 products belonging to the 'Smart Glass' category are displayed; all other products are excluded from the result set.

title: Verify selecting multiple categories filters using OR logic (union of results)
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters active
steps: Check the 'Smart Glass' category checkbox
Additionally check the 'Artwork' category checkbox
Wait for the page to reload with both category IDs in ?product_category[]=
Count the displayed product results
expected_result: Exactly 4 products are displayed — the union (OR) of 'Smart Glass' (3) and 'Artwork' (1) results, not their intersection.

title: Verify selected category filters float to top of the filter list with a 'Selected filters' summary
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters active
steps: Note the current position of 'Artwork' in the category checkbox list
Check the 'Artwork' category checkbox
Observe the re-ordered category list and any summary text above/below it
expected_result: 'Artwork' moves to the top of the category checkbox list, and a 'Selected filters: Artwork' summary line is displayed.

title: Verify filtering by a category with a unicode/emoji name returns the correct product
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters active

test_data.category: TEST 2. 🐶👍🔥 Modi quaerat fugiat alias distinctio.

steps: Locate the category checkbox with the unicode/emoji label 'TEST 2. 🐶👍🔥 Modi quaerat fugiat alias distinctio.'
Check that category checkbox
Count the displayed product results
expected_result: Exactly 1 product is displayed — the single product belonging to that unicode/emoji-named category. The category label renders correctly (no mojibake/broken characters).

title: Verify deselecting an active category filter removes it and updates the results
preconditions: Products page is loaded with 'Smart Glass' category filter already active (3 products shown)
steps: Uncheck the already-selected 'Smart Glass' category checkbox
Wait for the page to reload without the category param
Count the displayed product results
expected_result: The 'Smart Glass' filter is removed, the 'Selected filters' summary no longer lists it, and all 19 products are displayed again.

title: Verify category filter selection persists across browser back-navigation after opening a product
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters active
steps: Check the 'Smart Glass' category checkbox and wait for the filtered results
Click on one of the filtered product cards to open its detail page
Use the browser Back button to return to the products page
expected_result: The products page reloads with the 'Smart Glass' filter still active — the same 3 filtered products are shown, not the full unfiltered list.

title: Verify filtering via a manually edited URL with a non-existent category ID is handled gracefully
steps: Navigate directly to https://dev.skyline.glass/products/?product_category[]=999999
Observe the page response and product results
Check the browser console/network tab for errors
expected_result: Page loads without a 500 error or crash, and shows either 'No results found' or the full unfiltered list — never a broken page or exposed server error.
